outputs: Generated natural language texts such as summaries and titles
The paper evaluates language generation outputs such as summaries and titles in zero-shot settings.

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Paraphrase Generation' as it's not explicitly evaluated. Merged duplicate 'Title Generation' entries. Removed MAML/HNet as these are meta-learning methods applied to BART/T5, not separate models. Simplified output descriptions.
Normalized ROUGE-2F and ROUGE-L to base ROUGE form per guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation conducted in this paper
No human evaluation conducted in this paper - only automatic metrics (ROUGE) were used

overall_notes: The paper focuses on meta-learning approaches (MAML, HNet) applied to instruction-based natural language generation, specifically evaluating text summarization and title generation tasks using ROUGE metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but required some normalization and removal of non-primary items.
